description:
Join Apple's Human Interface Design (HID) team to develop advanced sensing, tracking, and classification algorithms to enable best-in-class user experiences across Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, and exciting new products. We are looking for a strong machine learning & DSP engineer with a passion for bridging algorithm development with embedded system design and software integration and leveraging GenAI tools into an engineering workflow. Our team brings togethers experts of diverse backgrounds: Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Firmware, Software, Physics, Mathematics, Human Factors, and more. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and design, collaborating with specialists across Apple to ship extraordinary products used every day by millions of people around the world.

Description
This is an machine learning engineering role at the HW/SW/UI boundary, with broad collaboration opportunities across firmware, software, and algorithms teams. You will be responsible for developing sensing algorithms using signal processing and machine learning techniques and delivering them as highly optimized, power-efficient code for custom silicon. You'll tackle complex challenges like memory constraints, computational budgets, and real-time performance while ensuring robust end-to-end functionality from sensor data acquisition through to the software layer to deliver exceptional user experiences. In this role, you will also lead efforts to identify, evaluate, and deploy GenAI tools that improve team productivity, including GenAI-assisted development, data analysis, and workflow automation. You will help define best practices for GenAI tool adoption within the group and collaborate cross-functionally to scale these efforts.

Responsibilities
Prototype and develop sensing, tracking, and classification algorithms to support new product form factors and new user-facing features
Develop and integrate robust C/C++ low-level software for deploying algorithms on microcontrollers, DSPs, and ML accelerators
Integrate algorithm implementations with the SW layer, ensuring correctness, performance, and stability across product configurations
Work with firmware and software engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from early prototyping through productization
Develop and maintain integration test frameworks and performance metrics to validate algorithm behavior end-to-end
Profile and budget algorithm compute/memory workloads on embedded platforms to guide silicon architecture teams on accelerator requirements, core selection, and memory sizing for future hardware
Identify and champion GenAI tools and developer productivity solutions that can be adopted within the team
Evaluate GenAI-assisted workflows (e.g., code generation, data analysis, automated testing) and driving their integration into team processes
Communicate findings, integration status, and tooling recommendations clearly to team members and leadership

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field and 3 years of relevant industry experience 
Strong software programming skills in C/C++, Python, and experience with embedded systems
Strong background in signal processing, machine learning and statistical learning algorithms
Experience with object-oriented programming and common software design patterns
Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to streamline daily workflows, accelerate coding and debugging, creating test frameworks and improve overall code quality and testing
Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills

Preferred qualifications
Master’s/PhD degree with 3+ years of experience in algorithm integration or embedded/software systems
Proven track-record in signal processing and machine learning, including areas such as time-series analysis, digital filtering, feature extraction, classification, regression, or neural network-based inference; experience applying these techniques to sensor data or embedded sensing systems is a strong plus
Familiar in C/C++ for embedded systems development, including RTOS, microcontrollers, and low-level hardware interactions 
Understanding of modern SoC/ASIC architectures, hardware neural/math accelerators, memory-bandwidth bottlenecks and experience with HW/SW partitioning for complex algorithms is a strong plus
Experience working at the HW/SW interface, including familiarity with firmware interfaces, driver layers, or OS-level integration
Hands-on experience prototyping, developing and integrating algorithm and signal processing code with software layer (e.g., OS-level frameworks, or application software)
Track record of evaluating, integrating and deploying AI-powered developer tools (e.g., LLM-assisted coding, AI-based test generation, intelligent data analysis pipelines)
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across firmware, software, and algorithms disciplines
